snippet.title: PAYDAY: Aces High - Reveal Trailer (Meta Quest, SteamVR, Steam Frame)
snippet.description:
Nothing hits like the moment the mask comes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. High stakes, big money, no mercy... Revenge has never felt so good.

PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players.

COMING 2026, WISHLIST NOW!

💰Meta Quest: ftg.gg/paydayah-meta
💰Steam: ftg.gg/paydah-steam
